pergunta: Which team did John sign with on 21 May, 2023?

focused_selection.text:
Session date: 7:48 pm on 21 May, 2023
[D1:2] Tim: Hey John! Great to meet you. Been discussing collaborations for a Harry Potter fan project I am working on - super excited! Anything interesting happening for you?
[D1:3] John: That's great! I just signed with a new team - excited for the season!
[D1:4] Tim: Woohoo! Congrats on the new team. Which team did you sign with?
[D1:5] John: The Minnesota Wolves! I can't wait to play with them!
[D1:6] Tim: Cool! What position are you playing for the team? Any exciting games coming up?
[D1:7] John: I'm a shooting guard for the team and our season opener is next week - so excited!
[D1:8] Tim: Cool! Have any goals in mind?
[...]
[D1:10] Tim: Sounds good! What challenges have you encountered during your pre-season training?
[D1:11] John: Fitting into the new team's style of play was a challenge during pre-season.
[D1:12] Tim: That sounds rough. How are things going with the new team?
[D1:13] John: Things are going well! The team has been really nice and I'm having fun. How's your fan project coming along?
[D1:14] Tim: It's been going well! Last week I talked to my friend who is a fan of Harry Potter and we're figuring out ideas, so it's been great to get lost in that magical world!

Session date: 1:08 pm on 11 August, 2023
[D6:12] Tim: Those shoes are special. They show your hard work, your successes, and all the amazing times you've had with basketball. It's awesome how meaningful objects can become. So inspiring. How did you get into the game?
[D6:13] John: Thanks! Basketball has been a part of my life ever since I was a kid. I'd watch NBA games with my dad and dream of playing on those big courts. When I turned ten, dad signed me up for a local league, and I've been playing ever since. I kept playing through middle and high school before earning a college scholarship. And after college, I was drafted by a team – my dream come true!
[D6:14] Tim: Wow! You really made your childhood dream come true. It's impressive how your dedication and hard work paid off. It's awesome how our passions shape our lives. Do you have any big goals for your basketball career?
[...]
[D6:23] John: Thanks! Talk to you later!
Session date: 7:54 pm on 17 August, 2023
[D7:1] John: Hey Tim! We had a wild few days since we talked. I met back up with my teammates on the 15th after my trip and it was amazing! Everyone missed me. The atmosphere was electric and I felt so welcome being back with them. I'm so lucky to be a part of this team!
[D7:2] Tim: Wow, John, that sounds amazing! I'm so happy they gave you a warm welcome back. It's such a special feeling when you realize that you share the same passions and talents with others. It's like finding your true place in the world.
[...]
[D7:4] Tim: Yeah, definitely. I felt like I belonged a few times, but last month at that event was one of my favorites. Everyone shared the same love for it and it felt like being in a world where everyone understood it. I'm really thankful for those experiences - it's great to know there are people out there who appreciate and share my interests.
[D7:5] John: Cool! It's great when you find a group that appreciates the same things. It really adds something special to our lives. So, do you have any exciting plans or events coming up?
[D7:6] Tim: I have no big events coming up, but I'm hoping to attend a book conference next month. It's an interesting gathering of authors, publishers and book lovers where we talk about our favorite novels and new releases. I'm excited to go because it'll help me learn more about literature and create a stronger bond to it.
[D7:7] John: You're a real bookworm! It would be awesome to go to a book conference with you. Check out this photo of what my teammates gave me when we met. It's a sign of our friendship and all the love we have for each other.
[D7:8] Tim: That's so cool of your teammates. Did they sign it for a special reason?
[D7:9] John: Thanks! They signed it to show our friendship and appreciation. It's a great reminder of our bond.

Session date: 1:50 pm on 17 October, 2023
[D14:2] Tim: Hey John! Long time no see! Can't wait to catch up and hear all about what you've been up to.
[D14:3] John: Seems like forever since we caught up! I'm now mentoring the younger players on my team. It's super rewarding and I'm loving sharing my skills and knowledge with them. It's also a great way for me to stay involved in the game during the off-season.
[D14:4] Tim: Wow! Mentoring must be so rewarding. You get to show others what you know - that's awesome! Is it difficult? Any hiccups?
[...]
[D14:20] Tim: Doing good! Busy with studies but finding time to relax with books - good balance.
[D14:21] John: Cool! Finding that balance is key. Are you currently reading any books?
[D14:22] Tim: I'm reading this book and I'm totally hooked! What about you?
[D14:23] John: I haven't had much time to read, but after we talked I finally picked up a book and it's been awesome! Talk to you later!
Session date: 5:51 pm on 21 October, 2023
[D15:1] Tim: Hey John! Haven't talked to you in a bit but wanted to let you know I read this awesome book about castles in the UK. It was so interesting and blew me away! I dream of visiting them one day.
[D15:2] John: Hey Tim! Great to hear from you. Learning about different cultures and seeing historical architecture fascinates me. Visiting castles is really on my bucket list. Just look at this one; what a sight! I'm so excited to explore the world and experience these gorgeous places. On that note, how's your fantasy writing going?
[D15:3] Tim: That castle looks amazing! I hope I get to visit it someday. My writing is going well: I'm in the middle of fantasy novel and it's a bit nerve-wracking but so exciting! All my hard work is paying off. Writing brings such joy and it's incredible how it can create a whole new world. Thanks so much for believing in me!
[D15:4] John: That's great! I'm glad your writing is going well. It must be exciting to see it all come together. Keep going! Do you have a specific source of inspiration for your stories?

Session date: 4:17 pm on 2 August, 2023
[D4:13] Tim: Same here!
[D4:14] John: Have fun with your writing! Catch you later!
[D4:15] Tim: Thanks! I'll enjoy writing them. Take care and talk soon!
Session date: 10:29 am on 9 August, 2023
[D5:1] Tim: Hey John! Long time no see! Been super busy lately. Guess what? Just skyped with that Harry Potter fan I met in CA and had a great time. We talked characters and maybe collab-ing - so cool to talk to someone who gets it. You? Anything new going on?
[D5:2] John: Hi Tim! Nice to hear from you. Glad you could reconnect. As for me, lots of stuff happened since we last talked. Last week I had a crazy game - crazy intense! We won it by a tight score. Scoring that last basket and hearing the crowd cheer was awesome!
[D5:3] Tim: Nice work! Bet it felt awesome to score that basket and have the crowd going wild. Must have been such an adrenaline rush! Did you manage to capture any other photos from the game?
[D5:4] John: Thanks! It was an amazing rush and just the one I showed you. We were so hyped!
[D5:5] Tim: Awesome! Winning a tough game must have been such an exhilarating experience!
[D5:6] John: Our team bond is awesome and it makes all the hard work worth it.
[D5:7] Tim: It's incredible how a team creates such strong ties. Having support like that is so important.
[D5:8] John: Thanks! You nailed it! Having a strong team/support is key - it's like a family away from home. We push each other to improve, and I'm so thankful for them.
[D5:9] Tim: That's great! Having a supportive team who are like family is awesome. Having people who motivate you and stick by you is priceless.

Session date: 3:00 pm on 2 October, 2023

[D12:27] Tim: That crowd looks wild! The game must've been amazing!
[D12:28] John: The energy was incredible! It's moments like these that make me love my job.
[D12:29] Tim: Cool! It's great to find something you enjoy doing. Keep going for it! See ya later!
Session date: 1:50 pm on 13 October, 2023
[D13:1] Tim: Hey John! It's been ages since we last talked. Guess what? Last week I went to a Harry Potter conference in the UK - it was incredible!
